_readme: Bionic Passport device data and decision thresholds. Read by the server (app/engine.py) and by the browser fallback (static/engine.js). Every value has an evidence level and a source. Values with evidence 'Placeholder' are PLACEHOLDER, replace with sourced data. Values with "verified": false have a real source that still needs checking. Mitigation text may use {pressure_kpa}.

temperature_margin_c.note: Minimum margin between cabin temperature and the device's operating limits before we flag it.

presumed_pressure_kpa.note: Used when a manufacturer publishes no pressure rating. Matches the 700 to 1060 hPa range that pump and knee makers publish.

not_compatible_fraction.note: Below half of the rated minimum pressure, the device counts as untested and high-risk.

implant_reference_kpa.note: Airliner cabins are held near 560 mmHg (74.7 kPa). People with implants experience this routinely.

source.title: Diabetologia (2024): insulin pumps in a hypobaric chamber at airliner cabin pressure

gas_expansion_airliner.note: An airliner climb (760 to 560 mmHg) caused unintended delivery of about 0.62% of the pump cartridge volume.

source.title: King et al. 2011, Diabetes Care: changes in altitude cause unintended insulin delivery from insulin pumps

oxygen_enriched_percent.note: Air above 23.5% oxygen by volume is oxygen-enriched: materials ignite and burn more easily.

source.title: US OSHA 29 CFR 1910.146: definition of oxygen-enriched atmosphere

dose_low_gy.note: Radiotherapy guidance for cardiac implants, used here only as an analogy for total dose.

source.title: AAPM TG-203 (Miften et al. 2019, Medical Physics): radiotherapy and cardiac implants
AAPM TG-203 (Miften et al. 2019, Medical Physics): radiotherapy and cardiac implants

live_session_max_delay_s.note: Longest one-way delay that still allows a live video session with a specialist.

devices.name: Powered knee prosthesis
devices.summary: A motorized knee that supports your weight and helps on stairs.

source.title: Össur Power Knee instructions for use (PKA01)
Össur Power Knee instructions for use (PKA01)

pressure_rating_kpa.note: 700 to 1060 hPa for use and for charging.

source.title: Össur Power Knee instructions for use (PKA01)

battery.note: 95 Wh lithium-ion pack. The manufacturer says the knee is not suitable near flammable mixtures with oxygen.

source.title: Össur Power Knee instructions for use (PKA01)

dust.note: Moving joint. The manufacturer says to remove the battery only in a dirt-free place.
dust.limit_text: Battery swap only in a dirt-free place

source.title: Össur Power Knee instructions for use (PKA01)

follow_up.note: Settings are changed by a prosthetist with fitting software.

gravity_function.note: The knee supports you when weight is applied and swings freely when unloaded, so its behavior depends on body weight.

source.title: Össur Power Knee instructions for use (PKA01)
Össur Power Knee instructions for use (PKA01)

stance_nm_per_kg.note: PLACEHOLDER, replace with sourced data: peak knee assist torque in stance per kg of body mass, from the user's own settings or published gait data.

swing_nm_per_kg.note: PLACEHOLDER, replace with sourced data: peak knee torque in swing per kg of body mass.

swing_gravity_share.note: PLACEHOLDER, replace with sourced data: share of the swing torque caused by the weight of the lower leg. The rest is inertia, which does not change with gravity.

scaling_source.title: Donelan and Kram 1997, J Exp Biol: walking kinematics change only modestly in reduced gravity

gravity.text: Recalibrate stance support with your prosthetist, starting from the values in the chart. Test it in a reduced-gravity analog such as a parabolic flight.

gravity_microgravity.text: Switch powered modes off when you are not walking, and plan socket adjustments because leg volume changes in microgravity.

pressure.text: Ask Össur for test data at {pressure_kpa} kPa, or run a low-pressure chamber test before the trip.

oxygen.text: Get a battery safety review for oxygen-rich air (NASA JSC 20793) and charge only in a monitored area.

temperature.text: Keep the knee and charger inside their rated temperatures.

dust.text: Keep a cover on the knee, clean it daily and swap the battery only in a clean area. This lowers the risk; it does not remove it.

light_delay.text: Agree setting presets with your prosthetist before you leave and train a crew member on the fitting app.

devices.name: Pacemaker
devices.summary: An implanted device that keeps your heart rhythm steady.

battery.note: Primary lithium cell sealed inside the implant.

devices.life_critical_note: We assume the person depends on pacing, the worst case. This flow does not ask.

follow_up.note: Clinics follow pacemakers through a home transmitter or phone app that uses Earth networks.

source.title: Heart Rhythm Society 2015 expert consensus on remote monitoring of cardiac implants

gravity_function.note: Rate-responsive pacemakers raise the heart rate from an accelerometer that senses body motion and vibration.

source.title: J Invasive Cardiology: accelerometer-based rate-adaptive pacemakers respond to environmental vibration

radiation_upsets.note: Memory upsets from neutrons were recorded in implanted defibrillators even at ground level.

source.title: Bradley and Normand 1998, IEEE Trans Nucl Sci: single event upsets in implantable cardioverter defibrillators

gravity.text: Ask your cardiologist to test the heart-rate response during exercise and adjust it before the trip.

pressure.text: Ask the manufacturer for low-pressure test data and have the device checked after arrival.

radiation.text: Have the device checked on a fixed schedule and after every solar storm, and learn its backup mode. This lowers the risk; it does not remove it.

light_delay.text: Bring a pacemaker programmer and train the crew medical officer. Send device data to your clinic when the link allows.

devices.name: Insulin pump
devices.summary: A wearable pump that delivers insulin through a thin tube.

battery.note: Battery type depends on the pump model.

devices.life_critical_note: Insulin is life-sustaining, but insulin pens are a backup route and worked in orbit.

life_critical_source.title: Burjeel Holdings and Axiom (2025): CGMs and insulin pens worked on the Ax-4 mission (press release)

dust.limit_text: Sealed case, no exposed moving parts

follow_up.note: Therapy runs on the pump; uploading data is optional.

gravity_function.note: Removing air bubbles relies on bubbles rising, and buoyancy depends on gravity.

gravity_microgravity.text: Practice a priming method that works without gravity before the flight.

pressure.text: Disconnect during pressure changes, then check for bubbles and re-prime. Ask the manufacturer for data at {pressure_kpa} kPa.

oxygen.text: Get a battery safety review for oxygen-rich air (NASA JSC 20793).

temperature.text: Keep the pump and insulin inside their rated temperatures.

radiation.text: Carry a spare pump and insulin pens, and check the delivery history after solar storms.

devices.name: Cochlear implant
devices.summary: An implant and an external sound processor that restore hearing.
devices.worn_note: Checks cover the external sound processor; the implant itself is sealed.

source.title: Cochlear Aqua+ accessory user guide: sound processor operating range

battery.note: Battery type depends on the processor model.

dust.note: Fine dust can block the processor's open microphone ports.

follow_up.note: An audiologist adjusts the processor program with fitting software.

pressure.text: Ask the manufacturer for test data at {pressure_kpa} kPa, or test the processor in a low-pressure chamber.

oxygen.text: Get a battery safety review for oxygen-rich air (NASA JSC 20793).

temperature.text: Keep the processor inside its rated temperatures.

dust.text: Use microphone covers, clean the processor daily and carry a spare processor.

light_delay.text: Agree program presets with your audiologist before you leave and carry the fitting software.

devices.name: Passive mechanical prosthetic knee
devices.summary: A hydraulic or pneumatic knee mechanism providing mechanical stance and swing resistance.

pressure_rating_kpa.note: Hydraulic sealed chambers tested across airline cabin pressures.

battery.note: Completely passive mechanical fluid mechanics; no battery required.

dust.note: Exposed mechanical pivots require protective gaiter in dusty environments.

follow_up.note: Manual hydraulic valve adjustment with an Allen key.

gravity_function.note: Hydraulic resistance calibrated for 1 g body weight; over-damps walking stride in lower gravity.

body_mass_kg.note: Rated weight limit for heavy-duty hydraulic knees.

stance_nm_per_kg.note: Peak passive hydraulic stance resistance torque.

swing_gravity_share.note: Pendular gravitational share of lower leg.

scaling_source.title: Biomechanical Scaling of Lower Limb Prosthetics

gravity.text: Adjust manual hydraulic stance valve 2 to 3 turns softer to prevent knee stiffness during reduced gravity gait.

dust.text: Fit protective neoprene gaiter boot over knee hydraulic cylinder and hinge joints.

pressure.text: Inspect hydraulic cylinder seals for fluid weeping during first 48 hours at habitat pressure.

devices.name: Powered bionic ankle-foot prosthesis
devices.summary: Motorized prosthetic ankle delivering active push-off propulsion during walking.

pressure_rating_kpa.note: Rated for airline cabin operating pressures.

dust.note: Ankle actuator gearing is sensitive to particulate contamination.

follow_up.note: Microprocessor firmware adjusted via Bluetooth tablet app.

gravity_function.note: Active push-off propulsion calibrated for Earth weight will launch user upwards in reduced gravity.

gravity.text: Reduce motor push-off energy setting by 60% to 80% to prevent excessive propulsion in reduced gravity.

dust.text: Install sealed carbon composite weather-resistant foot cover with silicone cuff seal.

devices.name: Implantable Cardioverter Defibrillator (ICD)
devices.summary: Implanted cardiac device that detects lethal arrhythmias and delivers high-energy electrical shocks.

battery.note: Hermetic lithium silver vanadium oxide / carbon monofluoride primary battery.

follow_up.note: CareLink home monitor uploads arrhythmia logs and lead impedance telemetry.

gravity_function.note: Accelerometers modulate pacing during activity; physical work requires different sensor tuning off-Earth.

radiation_upsets.note: High-voltage charging circuits and flash memory are vulnerable to single-event upsets from galactic heavy ions.

source.title: AAPM TG-203 Cardiac Implant Radiation Study

radiation.text: Enable daily autonomous capacitor conditioning and program monthly self-test memory diagnostics.

gravity.text: Adjust accelerometer threshold to low sensitivity setting to prevent inappropriate rate boost during microgravity movements.

light_delay.text: Equip mission medical kit with wand programmer for local emergency ICD interrogation and therapy locking.

devices.name: Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM)
devices.summary: Wearable subcutaneous biosensor tracking interstitial glucose levels in real time.

pressure_rating_kpa.note: Tested down to 70 kPa (3,000 meters altitude equivalent).

battery.note: Single-use sealed silver oxide button cell.

dust.note: IP28 water and dust ingress rating.

follow_up.note: Bluetooth telemetry streams to local phone or receiver independently of internet.

gravity_function.note: Enzymatic glucose-oxidase electrochemical reaction functions independently of gravity, tested in orbital parabolic flights.

pressure.text: Perform fingerstick capillary blood glucose calibration if rapid cabin pressure changes exceed 10 kPa in one hour.

devices.name: Deep Brain Stimulator (DBS)
devices.summary: Surgically implanted intracranial electrodes and neurostimulator treating Parkinson's, tremors, and dystonia.

dust.note: Subclavicular generator pocket with tunneled cranial leads.

follow_up.note: Inductive patient programmer allows user to adjust stimulation amplitude locally.

gravity_function.note: Electrical pulse generation across subthalamic nucleus operates independently of gravity.

radiation_upsets.note: Cranial exposure to cosmic ray heavy ions can cause soft resets of stimulation parameters.

radiation.text: Export and store baseline electrode impedance and voltage configuration to handheld patient programmer prior to departure.

light_delay.text: Train flight medical crew on clinician telemetry programmer to troubleshoot parameter resets without Earth contact.

devices.name: Ventriculoperitoneal (VP) Brain Shunt
devices.summary: Hydrocephalus drainage catheter and valve that diverts excess cerebrospinal fluid from cerebral ventricles.

battery.note: Passive differential fluid pressure valve with magnetic adjustment rotor.

source.title: Codman Certas Plus Programmable Valve IFU

devices.life_critical_note: Prevents catastrophic intracranial pressure elevation from hydrocephalus.

dust.note: Fully internal subcutaneous fluid drainage catheter.

follow_up.note: Non-invasive magnetic programming tool adjusts valve opening pressure.

gravity_function.note: Hydrostatic siphon effect depends on vertical gravitational column height. In microgravity or low gravity, hydrostatic siphoning disappears, reducing drainage rate.

gravity.text: Reprogram valve opening pressure to lower resistance setting to compensate for loss of vertical hydrostatic siphoning column.

pressure.text: Monitor daily for clinical signs of intracranial hypertension (headache, vision changes) during habitat pressure shifts.

devices.name: CPAP respiratory machine
devices.summary: Continuous positive airway pressure blower treating obstructive sleep apnea.

pressure_rating_kpa.note: Automatic altitude compensation calibrated down to 70 kPa (3,000 meters altitude).

battery.note: Optional external lithium battery backup pack.

dust.note: Pneumatic blower draws habitat air directly into patient airway.

follow_up.note: AirView cloud compliance upload is optional; machine displays AHI sleep metrics directly on screen.

gravity_function.note: Electric turbine blower generates differential pressure independently of gravity.

pressure.text: Manually recalibrate blower baseline pressure algorithm for 56.5 kPa habitat cabin atmosphere to maintain target airway pressure.

dust.text: Fit multi-stage medical grade HEPA allergen intake filter and replace filter cartridge every 14 days.

devices.name: Titanium orthopedic hip/knee joint implant
devices.summary: Passive internal titanium alloy endoprosthesis replacing damaged skeletal joint (Hayley Arceneaux type).

follow_up.note: Passive implant; requires no telemetry link.

gravity_function.note: Flew successfully on Inspiration4 with Hayley Arceneaux (first spaceflight participant with an internal prosthesis).

gravity.text: Maintain daily resistance exercise protocol using advanced resistive exercise device to prevent bone mineral loss around titanium stem.

devices.name: Leadless intracardiac pacemaker
devices.summary: Miniature transcatheter pacemaker implanted directly into right ventricular myocardium without chest pocket or leads.

battery.note: Lithium silver vanadium oxide / carbon monofluoride primary cell (1.0 cc volume).

gravity_function.note: 3-axis intracardiac accelerometer senses mechanical heart wall motion to boost rate.

radiation_upsets.note: CMOS integrated microcontroller vulnerable to single-event latchups.

radiation.text: Verify autonomous memory parity check is active and schedule weekly diagnostic self-checks.

gravity.text: Adjust 3-axis accelerometer motion sensitivity to compensate for altered ventricular wall kinetics in reduced gravity.

devices.name: Vagus Nerve Stimulator (VNS)
devices.summary: Implanted pulse generator and helical cervical electrode delivering programmed electrical pulses to the vagus nerve.

follow_up.note: Wand programmer and patient magnet allow manual on-demand stimulation.

gravity_function.note: Electrical pulse generator operates independently of gravitational acceleration.

radiation.text: Carry manual patient control magnet in flight kit to initiate or inhibit stimulation if microprocessor soft reset occurs.

devices.name: Mechanical prosthetic heart valve
devices.summary: Bileaflet pyrolytic carbon artificial heart valve replacing diseased aortic or mitral valve.

battery.note: Completely passive hemodynamic mechanical valve; zero electronics.

source.title: St Jude Medical Mechanical Valve IFU

devices.life_critical_note: Maintains unidirectional intracardiac blood flow; mechanical failure is fatal.

follow_up.note: Requires regular INR anticoagulation monitoring, not telemetry.

gravity_function.note: Bileaflet leaflets are driven by left ventricular pressure gradients (>100 mmHg), which dwarf gravitational hydrostatic forces.

pressure.text: Maintain strict point-of-care capillary INR fingerstick monitoring with coagulometer twice weekly to maintain safe anticoagulation window.

devices.name: Intraocular Lens Implant (IOL)
devices.summary: Artificial optical lens implanted into capsular bag following cataract surgery.

gravity_function.note: Capsular bag anatomical fixation is unaffected by microgravity; flown safely by multiple spaceflight participants.
